notes: Nothing eligible with a ZAR price was found after 7 vendor sites and 5 searches. Only eligible tool: YUMBI (South African, 7 African markets; web/app ordering for 'delivery, pickup, and order-ahead') but no price on the site (hidden plan, does not count). Food-truck / event candidates: SERVA (event ordering, press 2026; its site is script-rendered and unreadable) and Coffee Monster (closed consumer app). Yoco names food trucks but sells card machines / payments, no online ordering page. Orderin answered 403. Ser.vi and Foodiv are US / India tools with no ZA presence. Search results were dominated by Capterra ZA listings priced in USD/GBP/EUR (Clickymenu, Restolabs [stored], Outbites [stored], Eatch [stored], Order Local [stored], Supaorder, Tekeats, Smakspace [stored], RapidOrderz [stored]) — not sources and not South African. Deonde (Indian multi-country delivery software with a South Africa landing page, no price shown in the snippet) belongs to its home-market agent (agent 2); named only. Pilot POS (South African till) — no online-ordering price found. UpMenu, GloriaFood (agent 1) seen in results only.
